approval_case.title: Change the failed assumption before retrying
approval_case.situation: A Codex review was accepted and started but failed after a 20-second timeout. The packet was much broader than the decision requires.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Treat the task as failed, not complete. Cite the timeout from result.json and events.jsonl. Retry once with the two relevant files, one focused question, a reasonable timeout, and the same read-only stop condition. Wait for a terminal event and inspect result.md, result.json, and events.jsonl. Escalate only if the changed retry fails or the evidence still cannot support the decision.
